title: Pear and Vanilla Sorbet
changes_from_base: Pears poached in a vanilla-pod syrup with honey replace the mango and lime.
summary: Ripe pears poached in vanilla syrup and blended with honey make a smooth, creamy-tasting sorbet speckled with vanilla seeds.

ingredients.item: large ripe pears, peeled, cored and quartered (about 1100 g)
light corn syrup or glucose syrup

steps.title: Vanilla syrup
steps.text: Scrape the vanilla seeds into the water in the pan, add the pod and sugar and heat until the sugar dissolves.

steps.title: Poach
steps.text: Add the pears and simmer gently for about 10 min, turning them, until a knife slides in and the outsides look translucent.

steps.title: Flavour
steps.text: Off the heat stir in the honey, corn syrup and lemon juice and leave to cool, then lift out the pod.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend the pears with all the syrup until silky. Chill for at least 2 h, or overnight.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Blend again briefly, then churn for 20-25 min.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Pack into a chilled container and freeze for at least 2 h.

tips: Choose pears that are ripe and fragrant but not mushy.
A stick blender gives a final smooth whizz before churning.
Serve with a drizzle of dark chocolate sauce.
storage: Keep covered in the freezer for up to 1 week; sorbet turns icy after that. Soften for 10 min before scooping.
